 Prospect watch: UFC 334 KO artist Samuel Sanches
 Tudor Leonte Nov 13, 2026 
 Samuel
Sanches brings eight knockouts in 11 wins into his 
Ultimate Fighting Championship debut. The 23-year-old Brazilian
will face Evan Elder 
in a lightweight prelim at UFC
334 .
 Samuel Sanches brings eight knockouts in 11 wins into his UFC
debut against Evan Elder
A native of Salvador, Bahia, Brazil, Sanches is 11-1 and trains at
Galpao Da Luta. His opponents have a combined record of 68-93-2,
but the regional circuit gave “The Prodigy” time to develop before
taking on UFC competition.
 Advertisement 
Sanches trains under Jailton
Almeida , whom he 
regards as a godfather figure . Unlike his coach, Sanches leans
on his striking. He uses his kickboxing to score from range before
closing the distance with heavy punches.
Sanches made his professional debut shortly after turning 18,
stopping Joao Pedro 
in the first round under the Imperium MMA Pro banner. He won twice
more by knockout before Hugo Vargas 
handed him his only defeat with a kneebar. Sanches has since won
eight straight, including a second-round stoppage of Bruno Justo 
to claim the vacant Demo Fight lightweight title.
 “The Prodigy” Samuel
Sanches (9-1) vs Evaldo “Bolachinha” Santos(17-5) Thunder Fight
47 March 30th 2025 https://t.co/JyGl3S34F5
— Underrated Tribal Chief (@CombatUTC) 
September 9, 2025 
Sanches earned his UFC contract on Dana White’s Contender Series in
September 2025, knocking out Chasen
Blair with punches against the fence at 2:01 of the first
round. The finish showed what Sanches can do on the feet, though
the exchanges that preceded it left questions about his grappling
defense. Sanches was subsequently scheduled to face Tofiq
Musayev but withdrew due to injury.
 Samuel
Sanches delivering some violence on a Tuesday #DWCS
https://t.co/rZI4UH1jhS
— caposa (@Grabaka_Hitman) 
September 10, 2025 
Elder (10-2, 3-2 UFC) is among the toughest opponents Sanches has
faced. “The Phenom” is a well-rounded lightweight who has been out
of action since April 2025. If Elder can force Sanches to grapple,
the matchup should offer an early measure of how much the Brazilian
has improved since the Contender Series.
